title: HostManifest
description: Contrat de declaration d'un hote agnostique pour ManAgent. Ref: core/host_manifest.py

effects.description: Optional. Undeclared action = uncertain (cautious). See docs/ALIGNMENT.md.

effects_timeout_ms.description: Optional wait after action, milliseconds. Absent = no wait.

max_wait_ms.description: Optional per-tool active-wait ceiling (changing_effects). Absent = host default.

target_contract.description: Optional opaque-target contract (version 1). Invalid contract = tool stays usable but target-inert. Ref: docs/HOST_CONTRACT.md section 3i.

param.description: Top-level tool parameter. Reserved: source, source_data, sources. Must not declare an enum.

raw.description: allow = this parameter also accepts a host literal (e.g. surface=bureau): a known local name is still resolved, an unknown literal is forwarded unchanged. Required for a literal entry to survive egress.

items.description: Use scope XOR fields.scope. fields.ref is mandatory.

path.description: Dotted path relative to the full tool result (e.g. data.targets).

attributes.description: Free selector-visible fields: {public_name: read.path}. Never the raw reference.

kind_param.description: Optional name of the producer parameter selecting the produced target type (default convention: kind). The brain knows no type; it forwards the value.

kind_scopes.description: Optional declared table `produced type -> accepted input scopes` (e.g. {"ui": ["ui_preset"], "image": []}). An empty list is a strong declaration: no observed candidate can produce that type. Missing table, or table silent about the requested type = no conclusion; behaviour is unchanged and only target.kind_compat traces it. A refusal (TARGET_KIND_MISMATCH) is issued only on an explicit declaration, and only when no other input exists (no declared raw anchor, no per-item scope). The table is carried by the producer owning kind_param but evaluated on the candidates offered to the selector (the source's ones in a composite flow); never on the producer's own output payload. It governs local target scopes only.

occlusion.description: Optional declaration of published attributes carrying the occlusion fact. Names must exist in fields.attributes (otherwise the declaration is inapplicable and a contract warning is emitted). blocked_by => deterministic refusal (mismatch) without a model call; covers => never match (uncertain). The brain never infers occlusion from geometry or field names.

blocked_by.description: Attribute names whose non-empty/non-false value means the target is hidden.

covers.description: Attribute names whose non-empty/non-false value means the target covers another owner's content (never match, at best uncertain).

reliability.description: Optional reliability override for targets produced here. Applies only to projected candidates read via this producer. Absent = disclosure.reliability (default medium). Selects how deep target verification goes: high = light, medium = standard, low = deep + automatic zoom.

disclosure.description: Optional inspection recipe (version 1). The host declares named views, raw anchor kinds and allowed probes; the brain never invents a tool, a target type or an argument.

views.description: Named views the selector may read. Object form: {name: dotted.path}; array form: [{name, path, description}]. All views must share the coordinate frame in which anchors are resolved (usually the active frame); a crop or non-active frame must use another view name or be omitted.

anchors.description: Raw anchor kinds the host accepts. Object form: {kind: consumer_param}; array form: [{kind, param, description, reliability?}]. `kind` is HOST vocabulary (cell, file, key, joint...). `reliability` only affects projected candidates whose scope matches this kind; a raw anchor chosen directly is not verified by the current engine.

reliability.description: Optional global reliability profile for declared targets. Default medium (historical behavior). high = light verification, medium = standard, low = deep verification + automatic zoom when zoom_probe is declared.

evidence.description: Optional evidence types the host can attach to a candidate. Default [metadata]. These are NOT tool names: the brain only reads what is actually present. Images travel through the media channel, never base64 in the text prompt. `nested_targets` means the other visible candidates of the current world, not a nested structure: they may be inner to the chosen container or simply present on screen. The host needs no extra data for it.

zoom_probe.description: Optional id of a probes[] entry that inspects a LOCAL candidate (subject.kind='local'). Used by the harness for an implicit zoom after a mismatch: the selector is re-interrogated on the same candidate with the verifier hint. The verifier never chooses; it only orients. Bound: 1 zoom + 1 re-selection.

id.description: Stable probe identifier used by discovery_request.technical_goals.

kind.description: Free HOST vocabulary (widen, zoom, read_file, read_sensor...). The brain assigns no meaning to it.

tool.description: Declared host tool to run. Omitted = probe is not executable.

args.description: Fixed arguments sent verbatim (LLM cannot override them).

hint_param.description: Parameter that receives the natural-language question.

subject.description: Optional subject injected by the brain. kind='local' means a registry key; any other kind must be declared in anchors.

items.description: What the probe refreshes: candidates, a named view, media...

preserves_references.description: Optional, default false. True when the probe never reassigns already-issued references, so the brain may keep previous-world candidates alongside the new ones. A capture that invalidates old ids must leave this false.

returns.description: Typed output payloads (ManAgent vocabulary: MIME types). Optional; undeclared = text.

metadata.description: Optional host metadata. The brain only reads what it documents; unknown keys are ignored.

world_snapshot.description: Optional world-state source. max_chars is a CEILING: the brain asks for its own budget (2000 by default, configurable) and keeps the minimum of both. See docs/HOST_CONTRACT.md section 3g.

llm_policy.description: Optional per-usage-class call policy. Ref: docs/HOST_CONTRACT.md section 3j.

stall_interval_s.description: Heartbeat interval while a call is in flight. Default 30, bounds 1-300; 0/false/'off' disables. Never shortens the call budget.

stream_structured.description: Stream structured responses (default true). Providers that declare native streaming publish llm_call.first_byte_ms; others keep their classic path. false disables streaming everywhere. See docs/HOST_CONTRACT.md section 3j.

thinking_level.description: Neutral reasoning hint. Passed to the provider; ignored explicitly when it has no native translation. Absent = no default invented. See docs/HOST_CONTRACT.md section 3j.

reasoning_effort.description: Neutral reasoning hint. Same rules as thinking_level.
